description.zh:
是否发起异步作业。取值：

- **false**：不发起异步作业。
description.en:
Specify whether to run the job asynchronously. Valid values:

- **true**: Run the job asynchronously. We recommend this option.

- **false**: Run the job synchronously.

description.en:
Job input. For more information, see [Input details](~~29253#section-f3p-d24-y2b~~).

> - In MPS APIs, the Object value must be URL encoded using UTF-8.

- The region of the OSS bucket must match the region where MPS is deployed.

description.en:
Pipeline ID. For more information, see [Terms](~~29197~~).

- You can find or create pipelines in the [MPS console](https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview)>**Settings**>**Pipelines**.

- To receive asynchronous notifications, attach an MNS topic to the pipeline. For more information, see <props="china">[Receive message notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props> and <props="intl">[Receive message notifications](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mps/receive-message-notifications/?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.b48576d2jxNSca)</props>.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据。可以使用中英文、数字、中划线（-）等，不能以特殊符号开头，最大长度1024个字节。
description.en: User-defined data. You can use letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start with a special character. Maximum length: 1024 bytes.

descriptions.zh:
- 请确认文件已成功上传至OSS后再提交媒体信息作业，否则会导致执行失败。您可通过**配置OSS回调消息**确认文件上传状态。
- 媒体信息作业分为同步和异步模式。
- 异步模式不保证时效性，在提交媒体信息作业后，任务会添加到管道中排队，被调度执行。所以在接口返回时，不保证作业已经生成。执行完成后需要调用[查询媒体信息作业](~~602828~~)接口轮询执行结果，或通过为管道绑定MNS消息接收执行结果，详细说明请参见<props="china">[接收消息通知](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">[接收消息通知](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mps/receive-message-notifications/?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.b48576d2jxNSca)</props>。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- Ensure that the file is uploaded to OSS before you submit a media information analysis job. Otherwise, the job fails. You can use **OSS callback messages** to confirm the upload status.

- Media information analysis jobs support synchronous and asynchronous modes.

- The asynchronous mode does not guarantee timeliness. After you submit a job, it enters the MPS queue and waits for scheduling. The job may not be created at the time the API returns a response. To retrieve the result, you can poll the [QueryMediaInfoJob](~~602828~~) operation or configure MNS message notifications for the MPS queue. For more information, see <props="china">[Receive message notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props> and <props="intl">[Receive message notifications](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mps/receive-message-notifications/?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.b48576d2jxNSca)</props>.

## QPS limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single user is 50. If you exceed this limit, API calls are rate-limited. This may affect your business. Plan your API calls accordingly. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
